---
title: Create a feed cell
description: Create the cell your contract will read prices from.
---

```ts
import { ccc } from "@ckb-ccc/core";
import { LeanOracleTestnetClient } from "lean-oracle-sdk/client";

const oracle = new LeanOracleTestnetClient();
const signer = new ccc.SignerCkbPrivateKey(oracle.cccClient, privateKey);

const { tx, typeScript } = await oracle.createFeedCell({
  signer,
  feed: "Crypto.BTC/USDT",
  committee: "majors",
  // lock: optional; defaults to the signer's lock
});
const fee = await oracle.completeFee(tx, signer);
if (fee.status === "insufficient") throw new Error(`Needs ${fee.shortfall} more shannons`);
await signer.sendTransaction(fee.tx);
```

- **Keep `typeScript`.** Its hash identifies your cell for good. Put the hash in your contract's args
  or config.
- **Choose the lock deliberately.** It decides who can update and burn the cell. Use `lock` to set a
  multisig or a lock that lets keepers update it. See [Feed cells](/docs/learn/feed-cells).
- **The feed and committee are fixed** for the cell's life. For another feed, create another cell.
- **It starts empty.** The new cell has no price until its [first update](/docs/build/guides/update-feed-cell).

To find cells you created earlier: `oracle.findFeedCells("Crypto.BTC/USDT", "majors")`.
